brief:
AFC announces Saudi Arabia will host the 2027 Asian Cup beginning January 7, according to Al Jazeera English. The tournament's opening match will pit Saudi Arabia against Palestine in Riyadh. The confirmation came despite recent attacks in the region.

Saudi Arabia will host the competition as part of the country's expanded role in regional football. The tournament represents a major sporting event scheduled for the kingdom in the coming years.
dek: Asian Cup 2027 to kick off on January 7 with Saudi Arabia facing Palestine in Riyadh as the AFC announces the schedule.
title: Saudi Arabia to host Asian Cup starting January 7, 2027
